package db

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"database/sql/driver"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type failure struct{}

func (*failure) Error() string { return "failure" }

type connector struct{ s *stream }

func (c connector) Connect(context.Context) (driver.Conn, error) { return conn{c.s}, nil }
func (connector) Driver() driver.Driver                          { panic("unused") }

type conn struct{ s *stream }

func (conn) Prepare(string) (driver.Stmt, error) { panic("unused") }
func (conn) Close() error                        { return nil }
func (conn) Begin() (driver.Tx, error)           { panic("unused") }
func (c conn) QueryContext(ctx context.Context, _ string, _ []driver.NamedValue) (driver.Rows, error) {
	c.s.ctx = ctx
	return c.s, c.s.executeErr
}

type stream struct {
	ctx                           context.Context
	count, read, closed           int
	executeErr, nextErr, closeErr error
	bad, extra, noColumns         bool
}

func (s *stream) Columns() []string {
	if s.noColumns {
		return nil
	}
	return []string{"id", "name"}
}
func (s *stream) Close() error           { s.closed++; return s.closeErr }
func (s *stream) HasNextResultSet() bool { return s.extra }
func (s *stream) NextResultSet() error   { s.extra = false; return nil }
func (s *stream) Next(dst []driver.Value) error {
	if err := s.ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if s.read == s.count {
		if s.nextErr != nil {
			return s.nextErr
		}
		return io.EOF
	}
	s.read++
	dst[0] = int64(s.read)
	dst[1] = nil
	if s.bad {
		dst[0] = "not a number"
	}
	if s.read%2 == 1 {
		dst[1] = strings.Repeat("x", 64<<10)
	}
	return nil
}
func newQueries(t *testing.T, s *stream) *Queries {
	t.Helper()
	db := sql.OpenDB(connector{s})
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = db.Close() })
	return New(db)
}
func TestSequentialBoundedConsumption(t *testing.T) {
	s := &stream{count: 4096}
	q := newQueries(t, s)
	runtime.GC()
	var before runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&before)
	calls := 0
	err := q.Visit(context.Background(), func(row VisitRow) error {
		calls++
		if s.read != calls || row.ID != uint64(calls) || (row.Name == nil) != (calls%2 == 0) {
			t.Fatalf("read ahead/invalid row %d %+v", s.read, row)
		}
		if calls%512 == 0 {
			runtime.GC()
			var now runtime.MemStats
			runtime.ReadMemStats(&now)
			if now.HeapAlloc > before.HeapAlloc+16<<20 {
				t.Fatalf("retained result rows: %d", now.HeapAlloc-before.HeapAlloc)
			}
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil || calls != 4096 || s.closed != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("calls=%d close=%d err=%v", calls, s.closed, err)
	}
}
func TestFailuresAndCleanup(t *testing.T) {
	original := &failure{}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name          string
		setup         func(*stream)
		want          error
		calls, closed int
	}{
		{"empty", func(s *stream) { s.count = 0 }, nil, 0, 1},
		{"execute", func(s *stream) { s.executeErr = original }, original, 0, 0},
		{"iteration", func(s *stream) { s.nextErr = original }, original, 2, 1},
		{"close", func(s *stream) { s.closeErr = original }, original, 2, 1},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			s := &stream{count: 2}
			tc.setup(s)
			calls := 0
			err := newQueries(t, s).Visit(context.Background(), func(VisitRow) error { calls++; return nil })
			if !errors.Is(err, tc.want) || calls != tc.calls || s.closed != tc.closed {
				t.Fatalf("%v %+v calls=%d", err, s, calls)
			}
		})
	}
	s0 := &stream{noColumns: true}
	if err := newQueries(t, s0).Visit(context.Background(), func(VisitRow) error { t.Fatal("unexpected row"); return nil }); err == nil || s0.closed != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("missing result set: %v", err)
	}
	for _, extra := range []bool{false, true} {
		s := &stream{count: 2, bad: !extra, extra: extra}
		err := newQueries(t, s).Visit(context.Background(), func(VisitRow) error { return nil })
		if err == nil || s.closed != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("bad/extra result: %v %+v", err, s)
		}
	}
	s := &stream{count: 2}
	err := newQueries(t, s).Visit(context.Background(), func(VisitRow) error { return original })
	var typed *failure
	if !errors.Is(err, original) || !errors.As(err, &typed) || s.read != 1 || s.closed != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("callback failure: %v %+v", err, s)
	}
}
func TestCancellationNilAndPanic(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	s := &stream{count: 2}
	err := newQueries(t, s).Visit(ctx, func(VisitRow) error { cancel(); return nil })
	if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || s.read != 1 || s.closed != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("cancel: %v %+v", err, s)
	}
	if err := New(nil).Visit(ctx, func(VisitRow) error { return nil }); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := New(nil).Visit(context.Background(), nil); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("nil callback accepted")
	}
	s = &stream{count: 2}
	sentinel := &failure{}
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if recover() != sentinel {
				t.Fatal("panic changed")
			}
		}()
		_ = newQueries(t, s).Visit(context.Background(), func(VisitRow) error { panic(sentinel) })
	}()
	if s.read != 1 || s.closed != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("panic leaked result: %+v", s)
	}
}
